description: Use the browser.contextualIdentities API to query and modify contextual identity, also called as containers.

functions.name: get
functions.description: Retrieves information about a single contextual identity.

parameters.name: cookieStoreId
parameters.description: The ID of the contextual identity cookie store.

parameters.name: details
parameters.description: Information to filter the contextual identities being retrieved.

name.description: Filters the contextual identity by name.

functions.name: getSupportedColors
functions.description: Retrieves the list of colors supported by contextual identities.

color.description: The color name, as accepted by the color property of create and update.

colorCode.description: The color hash for this color name.

functions.name: getSupportedIcons
functions.description: Retrieves the list of icons supported by contextual identities.

icon.description: The icon name, as accepted by the icon property of create and update.

iconUrl.description: The icon url for this icon name.

functions.name: create
functions.description: Creates a contextual identity with the given data.

parameters.name: details
parameters.description: Details about the contextual identity being created.

name.description: The name of the contextual identity.

color.description: The color of the contextual identity.

icon.description: The icon of the contextual identity.

functions.name: update
functions.description: Updates a contextual identity with the given data.

parameters.name: cookieStoreId
parameters.description: The ID of the contextual identity cookie store.

parameters.name: details
parameters.description: Details about the contextual identity being created.

name.description: The name of the contextual identity.

color.description: The color of the contextual identity.

icon.description: The icon of the contextual identity.

functions.name: move
functions.description: Reorder one or more contextual identities by their cookieStoreIDs to a given position.

parameters.name: cookieStoreIds
parameters.description: The ID or list of IDs of the contextual identity cookie stores.

parameters.name: position
parameters.description: The position the contextual identity should move to.

functions.name: remove
functions.description: Deletes a contextual identity by its cookie Store ID.

parameters.name: cookieStoreId
parameters.description: The ID of the contextual identity cookie store.

functions.name: setSiteAssociation
functions.description: Associates a site with a container. Top-level navigations to that site will load in the given container.

site.description: The host to associate with the container (matched as an exact host).

cookieStoreId.description: The cookie store ID of the container to associate the site with.

functions.name: removeSiteAssociation
functions.description: Removes the container association for a site.

parameters.name: details
parameters.description: Details about the site association to remove.

site.description: The host whose container association should be removed.

functions.name: getSiteAssociation
functions.description: Retrieves the association of a site, or null if the site is not associated with any container.

parameters.name: details
parameters.description: Details about the site to look up.

allOf.name: association
allOf.description: The association of the site, null if the site is not associated with any container.

functions.name: querySiteAssociations
functions.description: Retrieves the list of site-to-container associations.

parameters.name: details
parameters.description: Information to filter the associations being retrieved.

cookieStoreId.description: If provided, only associations for this container are returned.

events.name: onUpdated
events.description: Fired when a container is updated.

allOf.description: Contextual identity that has been updated

events.name: onCreated
events.description: Fired when a new container is created.

allOf.description: Contextual identity that has been created

events.name: onRemoved
events.description: Fired when a container is removed.

allOf.description: Contextual identity that has been removed

events.name: onSiteAssociationChanged
events.description: Fired when a site-to-container association is added, changed, or removed.

cookieStoreId.description: The cookie store ID of the now-associated container, or omitted if the association was removed.

ContextualIdentity.description: Represents information about a contextual identity.

name.description: The name of the contextual identity.

icon.description: The icon name of the contextual identity.

iconUrl.description: The icon url of the contextual identity.

color.description: The color name of the contextual identity.

colorCode.description: The color hash of the contextual identity.

cookieStoreId.description: The cookie store ID of the contextual identity.

SiteAssociation.description: Represents the association between a site and a contextual identity.

site.description: The associated host, normalized to lower case and encoded as ASCII.

cookieStoreId.description: The cookie store ID of the contextual identity the host is associated with.
